title: Hadrian footer
description: A quiet navy footer under a full-width white hairline: wordmark and an uppercase mono nav on one row; the company name in wide caps, grey mono legal links and a small icon with the home country on the next. Centred and stacked on phones. Links turn gold on hover.
name: hadrian-footer

props.name: brand
props.description: the company name, set as the wordmark

props.name: company
props.description: the full company name, in wide caps on the second row

props.name: place
props.description: home country or city, last on the second row

props.name: placeIcon
props.description: a small icon before the place (e.g. a lucide icon), desktop only
